# #2794: Patch: card animations for the Classic set
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

Fill in the Classic set's card animation table, `apps/web/src/fx/cards/classic.json5` (#2784), for #2782.

**The set.** Classic has 90 cards (`classic-001` to `classic-090`) and 1 token:

- 56 are Spells, Field Spells, Traps or Field Traps, 16 of them Field Spells.
- 21 are Units with a Cry, Death, trigger or Activate in their text.

**Already bespoke.** BOOM! Big Max (classic-080), Nature Titan (classic-045) and Spell Tyrant (classic-056) have entrances (R670). Keep them, and give their other hooks entries.

**Read first.** `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`, and the "A task over every card" section of `docs/issues-and-patches.md`: this is a pass over every card.

### The measure

- **Spells and Traps.** Every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap gets a motif, or a bespoke key, on its `cast` hook.
- **Units with hooks.** Every Unit whose Cry, Death, trigger or Activate changes the board gets a motif on that hook.
- **Field Spells.** Every Field Spell also gets an `aura` entry.
- **Plain Units.** A vanilla Unit may be `"none: vanilla"`. A token gets an entry only where it earns one.
- **Picking.** Pick from `cargo jackioh fx census` (#2788), never by comparing card texts. Override the census's suggestion only with a reason. Use sub-looks (#2792) where cards of one flavor would blur together, and set the scale from cost and rarity.
- **Bespoke.** Give 3 to 6 cards a bespoke Flourish built from motif primitives, each with a one-line reason in the PR.
- **Legendary and Mythic entrances.** #2722's entrance and takeover animations are open to change (#2782); the owner finds them weak. A Legendary's or Mythic's Flourish may restyle its own entrance, and a Mythic its own takeover look, where the shared one doesn't suit the card. Do it through this set's table and its `fx/cards/<set>/` recipes; the shared takeover and the shared Legendary entrance in `fx/takeover.ts` are #2803's to rework. Keep the music (R2722000), when and for whom an entrance plays (R2722002) and the one capped hold (R2722001, as #2785 generalizes it). Update the tests that pin what you change, and amend R2722001 in this part's ruling note.
- **New motifs.** If 3 or more cards fit no motif, add one by the design doc's rule.
- **Set pieces.** List any set-piece candidates in the PR for the board-wipe or system parts of #2782, with a motif for now.

### The deliverable

A table in the PR with one row per Classic card: the id, the name, each hook's motif, palette and scale (or its key or `none` reason), the census suggestion, and why.

## Acceptance

- [ ] **Coverage.** At least 55% of Classic's 90 cards (50 or more) have an entry other than `none`, and every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry. A per-set test enforces this floor.
- [ ] **Auras.** Every Field Spell has an `aura` entry.
- [ ] **Bespoke Flourishes.** There are 3 to 6, each with a vitest and an R200 check.
- [ ] **Deliverable.** The PR's per-card table covers all 90 cards.
- [ ] **Hidden cards.** No hidden card keys an entry (R202).
- [ ] **Existing entrances.** The three entrances' tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] **Gallery.** The `/dev/fx` gallery plays every Classic entry.
- [ ] **Named constants.** Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] **Web checks.** Typecheck, tests and eslint pass, and the hotseat smoke settles.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2786, #2788, #2783 and #2792. Part of #2782.
